messages:
emma.docs: Heads-up: I'm doing a sweep of the onboarding quickstarts. Found 3 small but user-facing issues in hello-quicklaunch: wrong env var, outdated curl route, and a missing note about rate limits. Opening a PR shortly.

rahul.eng: appreciated. Which env var is wrong?

emma.docs: README shows EXAMPLE_KEY everywhere. Should be REDWOOD_API_KEY and we should show `export REDWOOD_API_KEY="<key>"` in all shells. Also the curl examples call /v1/generate; new route is /v1/text/generate.

lee.devex: saw that too in last week's onboarding lab. Also the TypeScript snippet imports `new Redwood()` instead of `new RedwoodClient()` for SDK v4. People copy-paste and hit runtime errors.

michael.pm: oof. Can we add a short migration note for SDK v3->v4 with the common rename patterns? Put a link to /docs/migrations/sdk-v3-to-v4.

emma.docs: yes. PR will include: env var fixes, curl route fixes, TS/JS/Py snippet alignment, and a brief migration note. I'll also add a small section about token scopes and rate limit headers so users know how to debug 429s.

ci-bot: CI: docs lint check started for branch docs/quicklaunch-fix (sha: def456).

rahul.eng: can you also standardize the example prompt? I'd recommend a minimal prompt and a suggested temperature of 0.1 for deterministic starter behavior.

lee.devex: add a Docker quicktest example too. Many attendees run in Docker and the docs didn't show passing env vars into the container. Small snippet: `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY hello-quicklaunch`.

emma.docs: good call. I'll add that. Also I noticed a dead link to /docs/intro#auth — will replace with /docs/auth/#overview and add a redirect in the site config.

ci-bot: docs lint passed. Link-checker: 1 broken link found: /docs/intro#auth.

emma.docs: fixed the anchor in the PR and added the redirect rule in site/_redirects. Pushed commit.

michael.pm: who will QA before merge? @lee.devex can you smoke test Node/TS/Python + Docker locally?

lee.devex: on it. Running local smoke now.

ci-bot: staging deploy triggered for docs site for branch docs/quicklaunch-fix (ETA ~4m).

lee.devex: QA notes: Node and Python examples run with a fresh API key. TypeScript example fixed to use `RedwoodClient` and the constructor shape matches SDK v4. Docker example works when env var passed. One tiny thing: the README had an example using `temperature: 1.0`; I changed to `0.1` per the deterministic recommendation and added a short explanation. Pushed a tiny grammar fix too.

emma.docs: nice. I also added a CHANGES.md entry under quickstarts summarizing edits so we can track docs-only changes.

ci-bot: staging deploy successful (sha: def456).

michael.pm: looks good. Please merge once you're happy. Also add a short blurb in the release notes about the redirect so external partners are aware.

emma.docs: merging now. :ship:

ci-bot: production deploy queued for docs site (include redirects).

lee.devex: quick suggestion: add a troubleshooting bullet about corporate proxies and outbound port blocking; had one external customer hit that and it slowed their trial.

emma.docs: added it to troubleshooting. Closing thread after prod deploy completes. Thanks everyone! :tada:
